(user maintenance preferred) - Operating Temperature range at least -10 to 40C, - The drone should be equipped with a location positioning system (GNSS: GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo). Drone can take off and land autonomously to the docking station, docking station closes around the drone to protect it from weather, the batteries are charged/swapped automatically by the dock, data from previous fights will be uploaded to cloud either directly from the drone or via the docking station.
